shortcut.description.directory.search: Focus the project search field on the home page.
directory.removeDataHint: Choose what to keep in .texweave. Source files, images, references and PDFs outside this folder are preserved.
directory.removeData.allHint: Keep settings, snapshots, formal versions and cached data.
directory.removeData.versionsHint: Keep formal versions and their restoration data; remove other TeXWeave data.
directory.removeData.noneHint: Delete .texweave, including settings and all history.
settings.defaultProjectDirectoryHint: Pre-filled when creating a new project. You can choose another folder.
history.clearSnapshotsConfirm: Delete all {{count}} snapshots? This cannot be undone. Formal versions and temporary saves will be kept.
environment.preview.listChanged: This item changed while editing. Close and reopen its editor.
table.splitHint: Split merged cells intersecting the selection. Ordinary cells do not need splitting.
colors.modeHint: Adaptive colors follow the theme. Fixed mode keeps explicit color values.
colors.themeHint: Parameters apply to the current theme. Defaults come from its CSS; reset removes your overrides.
shortcut.description.sidebar.files: Show or hide the file panel.
shortcut.description.sidebar.search: Show or hide the search panel.
shortcut.description.sidebar.library: Show or hide the project library.
shortcut.description.sidebar.help: Show or hide the help panel.
settingsPresets.title: Settings presets
settingsPresets.hint: Presets save global settings. Project overrides and detected toolchains are preserved.
settingsPresets.name: Preset name
settingsPresets.updateConfirm: Replace “{{name}}” with the current global settings and name?
settingsPresets.deleteConfirm: Delete preset “{{name}}”? Current settings will remain unchanged.
settingsPresets.duplicateName: A preset with this name already exists.
settingsPresets.limit: You can save up to 100 presets.
settingsPresets.failed: Could not complete the preset operation.
settingsPresets.imported: Preset imported; select Load to apply it.
settingsPresets.invalidFile: The file is invalid or belongs to another manager.
settingsPresets.managerHint: Only this manager’s settings are saved. Resources and skills are merged on load; other entries are kept.
settingsPresets.dictionaryHint: Saves spelling preferences and language choices. Dictionaries are installed and removed separately.
settingsPresets.placeholder: Reserved: this manager has no configurable settings yet.
native.retentionInvalid: Choose a valid project data retention option.
settings.pdfFollowActiveTex: Switch PDF preview when switching TeX files
pdf.localLinkUnavailable: The linked PDF is not available in this project.

export.compileForDependencies: This document uses dynamic file paths. Compile the main document, then export again, or export all source files.
image.layout.title: Layout
image.layout.dragHint: Drag an image to another cell to swap positions.
image.layout.capacity: This layout cannot hold all existing images and subfigure metadata. Choose more cells.
image.layout.complex: This figure uses a complex layout. Use Advanced source editing to preserve its custom code.
image.layout.packageConflict: The required subfigure package conflicts with an existing package. Adjust the preamble in source mode.
image.layout.noPreamble: A document preamble could not be found for the subfigure package. Set the project main file first.
image.layout.changed: The figure or preamble changed while editing. Select the figure again.
image.clipboard.title: Paste from clipboard
image.clipboard.description: Save a copy to the project image folder.
image.clipboard.empty: The clipboard does not contain an image.
toolchainInstall.title: Install LaTeX tools
toolchainInstall.hint: Choose a distribution and the components you need. Downloads are verified before installation. Existing environments can receive additional packages.
toolchainInstall.folderHint: Choose an empty folder or a matching environment previously installed by TeXWeave.
toolchainInstall.windows: Automatic installation is currently available on Windows x64.
toolchainInstall.phase.complete: LaTeX tools are installed and ready.
settings.projectCacheHint: Clears build caches and saved view positions for all registered projects, browser cache, and the project list. Source files, images, exported PDFs, snapshots, project settings and AI conversations are kept. Projects can be opened again from their folders.
settings.projectCacheIdle: Close all projects and wait for compilation and AI tasks to finish before clearing.
settings.projectCacheConfirm: Clear caches and remove all projects from this computer’s project list?
setup.title: Set up TeXWeave
setup.subtitle: Choose spelling languages and prepare LaTeX tools. You can change these later in Settings.
setup.languagesHint: English dictionaries are included. Additional languages require an internet connection.
setup.incomplete: You can finish now and configure missing tools later in Settings.
setup.languageError: Some languages could not be installed. Retry or clear their selections to continue.
setup.statusError: The initial setup status could not be read.
toolchainInstall.description.miktex: Start with Basic MiKTeX and add selected packages. Suitable for a small installation that grows with your documents.
toolchainInstall.description.tinytex: Portable TeX Live based on TinyTeX. Includes Perl and supports selected packages or the complete TeX Live package collection.
toolchainInstall.existing: Add components to the current environment
toolchainInstall.existingHint: Selected packages will be added to the environment shown above. Existing packages and documents are kept; no distribution is reinstalled.
toolchainInstall.core: Included: pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX, LuaLaTeX, latexmk, BibTeX, Biber and MakeIndex. Components below add document packages.
toolchainInstall.componentHint.chinese: ctex, xeCJK, fontspec and Fandol fonts
toolchainInstall.fullHint: Install all packages offered by this distribution. Requires substantially more disk space and download time; system fonts and external tools may still be needed.
toolchainInstall.customHint: Enter package IDs from the selected distribution, separated by spaces or commas. Dependencies are installed automatically.
toolchainInstall.auto: Automatically download missing MiKTeX packages during compilation
toolchainInstall.autoHint: Applies to the selected MiKTeX environment and requires internet access.
toolchainInstall.texLiveAuto: Automatically install missing TeX Live packages during compilation
toolchainInstall.texLiveAutoHint: Applies to TeX Live and TinyTeX. Searches the selected environment’s repository, installs missing packages, then retries compilation. Requires internet access and permission to manage that environment.
ai.environmentHint: Detect, install or configure Codex CLI. Windows downloads the official native package with integrity verification; Node.js and npm are not required. After installation, sign in from the Codex panel.
helpMode.title: Help mode
helpMode.hint: Hover over or click a region to learn what it does. Clicks explain controls without running them. Use Previous / Next to explore; exit to resume editing.
helpMode.create: Create a project folder and its main TeX file. Style resources are optional; choose Empty to start without a style template.
helpMode.import: Register an existing LaTeX project folder. Its source files stay in their original location.
helpMode.projects: Open a project by clicking its row. Stars and pins help organize projects. Removing an entry from this list is separate from deleting its files.
helpMode.findProject: Search registered projects by name or path. Use the tabs, sort order and density controls to organize the list.
helpMode.activity: Choose Files, Search, Library, AI, History or Relations here. Click the same tool again to hide its panel. Settings and Help are at the bottom.
helpMode.files: Browse project files and click one to open it. The star marks the main TeX file. Filter and sort the list above; the header arrow folds this section.
helpMode.outline: Navigate document headings by clicking an entry. Expand nested headings or collapse the whole section using its header arrow.
helpMode.views: Code edits raw LaTeX; Visual displays editable blocks and rendered formulas. Switching views keeps your document position. Layout controls also arrange editor and PDF panes.
helpMode.insert: Insert sections, environments, mathematics, figures, tables and references at the current editing position.
helpMode.tabs: Switch between open source files here. A dot marks unsaved changes; the small cross closes a tab.
helpMode.editor: Edit the current file here. In Code, type LaTeX directly. In Visual, select a block to edit or rearrange it; use its source editor when needed. Save with Ctrl+S (Command+S on macOS).
helpMode.compile: Compile a TeX document into a PDF. Choose pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX to match the project. Missing tools can be installed from Settings → Local LaTeX toolchain.
helpMode.pdf: View compiled output here. The PDF selector switches documents; zoom and fit controls adjust the page view. Compile after editing to refresh the PDF.
helpMode.sidebar: This panel shows the selected tool. Search finds text and filters blocks; Library manages references; AI assists with edits; History restores snapshots; Relations explores block links.
helpMode.resize: Drag this divider to resize neighboring panes. Folding a section keeps its header available so you can expand it again.
helpMode.status: See the active file, cursor position and compilation status. Error and warning buttons open diagnostics; the bottom panel provides problems and compilation logs.
helpMode.settings: Configure the application or current project here. Managers organize themes, block environments, shortcuts and other resources. The toolchain page detects or installs LaTeX.
helpMode.workspace: The main work area contains the document editor and PDF preview. Use the view and layout controls above to select Code, Visual or a split layout.
shortcut.description.help.toggle: Hover over or click a region to learn what it does. Clicks explain controls without running them. Use Previous / Next to explore; exit to resume editing.
helpMode.library: Manage references in the full library: search entries, inspect or edit their fields, organize tags and import bibliographic data. Project citations connect to entries through citation keys.
helpMode.menus: The top bar contains File, Edit, View and History menus, a project switcher and save status. Click the application logo to return to the project home page.
helpDetail.insert.section: Insert a section heading at the current position. Change its title in the source or the Visual block header; it then appears in the outline.
helpDetail.insert.environment: Open the environment picker, search for an enabled environment, and insert its matching begin/end pair. Environment definitions come from the block manager.
helpDetail.insert.bold: Insert a textbf command or apply it to the selected text. This formats ordinary LaTeX text as bold.
helpDetail.insert.math: Insert a display-math template at the editing position, then replace its contents with your formula. The rendered result is visible in Visual mode.
helpDetail.insert.figure: Open the image insertion dialog. Choose an image from the project, a local file or the clipboard, and configure a figure or subfigure layout.
helpDetail.insert.table: Open the table creation dialog to choose rows, columns and style. After insertion, select cells in Visual mode to edit the table structure.
helpDetail.insert.reference: Insert a ref command for a document label. Choose or enter its key; modifier-click on a resolved reference navigates to its target.
helpDetail.insert.citation: Insert a cite command for a bibliography key. Find available entries in the project references or library before choosing the key.
helpDetail.block.create: Turn the current selection into a custom block, or edit the currently selected custom block. Select a valid range first; a disabled button means no usable range is available.
helpDetail.whitespace: Toggle visible whitespace markers in the source editor and Visual source-editing fields. This only changes the display, not spaces in the file.
helpDetail.code: Switch to the raw LaTeX source editor. It offers syntax highlighting, completion, folding and direct text editing.
helpDetail.visual: Switch to the editable block preview. Formulas and citations are rendered; select a block to edit its contents or open its source.
helpDetail.unmatched: Choose how blocks outside the active filter appear: unchanged, dimmed, collapsed or removed from view. This does not delete source content.
helpDetail.compile: Compile the current TeX target to PDF with the selected engine. The button is unavailable while compilation is running; inspect Log for failures.
helpDetail.engine: Choose pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX for this project. Match the engine to the document packages and fonts; missing engines are configured in the toolchain manager.
helpDetail.compileLog: Open the compilation log panel. Select a compilation result to inspect its output and use reported file/line information to investigate an error.
helpDetail.outputView: Switch the output pane between the compiled PDF and the editable Visual preview. Visual updates from source; PDF updates after compilation.
helpDetail.pdf.document: Choose which project PDF to preview. Status icons distinguish available and uncompiled documents. Following the active TeX file can be configured in Settings.
helpDetail.pdf.zoom: Increase or decrease PDF magnification, or choose a fixed percentage, Fit width or Fit page. This affects preview size only.
helpDetail.file.filter: Filter the project tree by file name to locate a source or asset. Clearing the field restores the normal tree; files are not removed.
helpDetail.file.sort: Sort project files by type or name. The direction button reverses the order; this does not rename or move files.
helpDetail.file.new: Create a new file in the project. Enter a path and file name with the required extension, such as chapters/introduction.tex.
helpDetail.file.refresh: Read the project directory again to display files added, moved or removed outside the application.
helpDetail.section.collapse: Fold or reopen this section. Its contents and settings remain available, and the section header stays visible so it can be expanded again.
helpDetail.search.text: Search for text in the selected scope. Enter moves to the next match; Shift+Enter moves to the previous match. Search options refine matching.
helpDetail.search.case: Match upper- and lower-case letters exactly. When off, searching for a word can match different letter cases.
helpDetail.search.word: Match a complete word instead of a substring. This option is unavailable when regular-expression search is enabled.
helpDetail.search.regex: Interpret the query as a regular expression. Invalid expressions display an error; disable this option to search ordinary text literally.
helpDetail.search.scope: Choose whether text search covers only the current file or the entire project. Results include the file and line position.
helpDetail.search.replace: Expand replacement controls, enter replacement text, then replace the current match or all eligible results. Replacement is unavailable for read-only or incomplete results.
helpDetail.search.navigate: Jump to the previous or next search result. Select a result row to go directly to its file and text position.
helpDetail.search.clear: Clear the text query without changing the document. Filter conditions are managed separately in Filters.
helpDetail.filter.enable: Enable or disable block filtering while keeping the selected conditions. Filtering affects highlighting and display; it never deletes source blocks.
helpDetail.filter.all: Set all filter groups to include or exclude together. Each group can then be adjusted independently using its own mode button.
helpDetail.filter.mode: Switch this group between including and excluding its selected options. This changes how the selected block types, locations, files or properties are matched.
helpDetail.filter.search: Search the available choices in this filter group. Typing narrows the option list; it does not select options or search document text.
helpDetail.filter.choice: Select or deselect this condition. The group include/exclude button determines whether matching content is retained or excluded.
helpDetail.filter.clear: Clear all selected block-filter conditions while retaining the filter enable state and unmatched-block display mode.
helpDetail.ai.provider: Choose the Copilot or Codex conversation provider. Each uses its own account and conversation state; switching may be unavailable during an active request.
helpDetail.ai.new: Start a new conversation for the selected provider and project. Existing conversations remain accessible in conversation history.
helpDetail.ai.history: Open recent conversations and conversation management. Search, select and reopen a previous conversation here.
helpDetail.ai.rename: Rename the current conversation to make it easier to find later. This does not resend its messages.
helpDetail.ai.model: Choose the model used for future requests in this conversation. Available models depend on the selected provider and account.
helpDetail.ai.permission: Choose the AI permission policy. Approve for me can apply permitted low-risk edits automatically; review policies require approval. Applied edits can be undone from their report.
helpDetail.ai.effort: Choose a supported reasoning-effort level or use the model default. Availability and response time depend on the model and provider.
helpDetail.ai.attach: Attach files or images as context for the next message. Draft attachments are retained when leaving the AI panel until removed or sent.
helpDetail.ai.selection: Include the editor selection as context for the next request. Check the selected text before sending so the AI receives the intended passage.
helpDetail.ai.expand: Expand the composer into a larger writing panel. Click outside or use the same control again to return to the compact composer without losing the draft.
helpDetail.ai.stop: Request cancellation of the currently running AI task. Stopping does not automatically undo file changes already applied.
helpDetail.ai.send: Send the draft and attachments. If another request is running, this message is queued and processed after earlier queued messages.
helpDetail.ai.queue: Send this queued message immediately by interrupting the active request. Other queued messages remain queued.
helpDetail.ai.queueRemove: Remove this unsent message from the queue. It will no longer run automatically after the current task.
helpDetail.ai.undo: Undo the applied changes shown in this report. Undo may be rejected if later edits overlap; inspect the diff before retrying.
helpDetail.ai.diff: Inspect the affected files and line differences before and after the AI edits. Viewing the report does not apply another edit.
helpDetail.ai.dismiss: Dismiss this change report from the conversation. This clears the report card, not the file edits or the entire conversation.
helpDetail.block.up: Move the selected blocks upward in document order. Their complete source contents move together.
helpDetail.block.down: Move the selected blocks downward in document order. Their complete source contents move together.
helpDetail.block.outdent: Move the selected blocks out by one structural nesting level where the document structure permits it.
helpDetail.block.indent: Nest selected blocks one structural level deeper where a valid parent block is available.
helpDetail.block.copy: Copy the selected blocks and their LaTeX contents to the clipboard. The original blocks stay in the document.
helpDetail.block.cut: Copy the selected blocks to the clipboard and remove them from the document so they can be moved by pasting.
helpDetail.block.paste: Paste compatible clipboard block contents at the current block insertion location.
helpDetail.block.duplicate: Create another copy of the selected blocks in the document. Review copied labels to avoid duplicate reference keys.
helpDetail.block.collapse: Fold or unfold the selected blocks or the indicated children/siblings. This affects navigation and display without removing their source.
helpDetail.block.disable: Disable or re-enable selected blocks using the block operation system. This changes block state; use collapse instead if you only want to hide their contents.
helpDetail.block.delete: Remove the selected blocks and their source contents from the document. Use Undo if the deletion was unintended.
helpDetail.table.rows: Insert a row above or below the selected table region. Select a cell first; unsupported table syntax can make structural operations unavailable.
helpDetail.table.columns: Insert a column to the left or right of the selected table region. Select a cell first to determine the insertion position.
helpDetail.table.delete: Delete the selected row or column and its cell contents. Deleting the last remaining row or column is restricted.
helpDetail.table.merge: Merge a rectangular selection of multiple cells. The operation requires an editable table and a valid, unmerged selection.
helpDetail.table.split: Split merged cells in the selected region. Select a merged cell first; ordinary single cells cannot be split by this command.
helpDetail.figure.layout: Set the subfigure row/column layout and apply it to the figure. More slots allow more images; remove unneeded slots to reduce the figure.
helpDetail.figure.remove: Remove this image slot from the figure layout. The original image asset remains in the project for reuse.
helpDetail.figure.slot: Select an image slot for inspection. Drag image slots to rearrange subfigure order; locate or replace the selected image using the inspector.
helpDetail.history.create: Save the current project as a snapshot or named version. A meaningful name helps identify a restore point before larger changes.
helpDetail.history.restore: Restore the chosen snapshot or selected files. Review the file list and confirmation because restoring replaces current contents.
helpDetail.history.storage: Optimize snapshot storage or clear stored snapshots, according to the selected action. Clearing snapshots removes restore points, not project source files.
helpDetail.relation.focus: Set the selected block as the relation focus. Direction and depth then determine which linked blocks appear around it.
helpDetail.relation.locate: Navigate to the selected relation block in the document, keeping the relation view available for further exploration.
helpDetail.library.search: Find bibliography entries by title, author or citation key. Type and collection filters further narrow the available entries.
helpDetail.library.import: Add references through the available BibTeX import or entry form. Importing into the library and adding a reference to a project are separate actions.
helpDetail.library.cite: Insert this bibliography entry as a citation at the editor cursor. A writable TeX file must be open.
helpDetail.manager.presets: Open named presets for this manager. Save or export the current configuration, then load or import a preset when switching workflows.
helpDetail.manager.tabs: Switch between the graphical editor and Advanced XML for the same environment definitions. Review or save edits before leaving the manager.
helpDetail.manager.import: Import the selected resource file or folder into this manager. Themes use CSS; style resources supply files for project creation.
helpDetail.manager.search: Find settings or definitions in the current manager. Search only changes the displayed list; it does not edit the underlying configuration.
helpDetail.manager.scope: Choose the available settings scope or Basic/Advanced level. Check whether an option applies to this computer, all projects or the current project.
helpDetail.toolchain.detect: Recheck installed LaTeX tools, or locate an installation directory or executable manually. Detection does not download a new distribution.
helpDetail.toolchain.install: Open installation or repair options for missing LaTeX tools. Confirm a destination folder and distribution before starting the network download and setup.
helpDetail.unavailable: Currently unavailable: check the selection, file, running state or permission requirements described above.
helpDetail.menu.file: Create or import files, save one or all open files, export the main PDF or source ZIP archives, and close the project. Export options differ in what they include.
helpDetail.menu.edit: Undo or redo edits, find or replace text, and format LaTeX source. Availability depends on the active editor and file permissions.
helpDetail.menu.view: Choose Code, Visual or PDF, and switch between a single pane and a split layout. The file contents are preserved when changing the view.
helpDetail.menu.history: Open automatic snapshots or named project versions to inspect changes and choose a restore point.
helpDetail.save: Save the current file, or all open files when Save all is selected. The top-right status indicates whether changes are saved or still pending.
helpDetail.source.format: Reformat supported LaTeX source to improve indentation and layout. This edits source text, so inspect the result and use Undo if needed.
helpDetail.export.pdf: Export only the main TeX document PDF. Compile the main document first if no valid PDF is available.
helpDetail.export.all: Create a ZIP containing the project source files and assets for sharing or backup, rather than only the current file.
helpDetail.export.related: Create a source ZIP based on files related to the main document. This helps share the main article without unrelated project documents.
helpDetail.relation.direction: Choose prerequisites, consequences, or both directions around the focus block. This changes which relation paths are explored.
helpDetail.relation.depth: Limit how many relation links are traversed from the focus block. Choose All to explore all reachable levels.
helpDetail.relation.filter: Filter the document view to the current relation scope. Turning this off keeps the relations available while restoring the full document view.
helpDetail.relation.back: Return to the previous relation focus. The button is unavailable until a focus history exists.
helpDetail.library.tabs: Switch between finding entries in the full library and viewing bibliography entries already available in this project.
helpDetail.library.add: Add this library reference to the current project. This makes it available for project citations; it is separate from inserting a citation at the cursor.
helpDetail.library.full: Open the full reference-library manager to import or edit entries, organize tags and inspect bibliography details.
helpDetail.ai.copy: Copy this message text to the clipboard. Attachments and file edits are not copied by this button.
helpDetail.ai.edit: Edit the last eligible user message and resend it. Earlier user messages are not editable through this control.
helpDetail.ai.bottom: Scroll to the newest messages in this conversation without changing the draft or interrupting the active request.
helpKeyboard.hint: ← / →: browse this level · Q: enter · Backspace: parent · Esc: exit
